import json
import datetime as dt

# Question 1: 8-year construction starting 2005-02-23
start = dt.date(2005, 2, 23)
ready = start.replace(year=start.year + 8)
X = ready.year

# Question 2: age in days from 2008-03-22 to 2015-10-19
Y = (dt.date(2015, 10, 19) - dt.date(2008, 3, 22)).days

# Question 3: whole months from 2005-06-14 to 2005-12-14
d1 = dt.date(2005, 6, 14)
d2 = dt.date(2005, 12, 14)
Z = (d2.year - d1.year) * 12 + (d2.month - d1.month)
if d2.day < d1.day:
    Z -= 1

# Derived values
Xp = X - 1992
Yp = Y - 2756
Zp = Z + 1873

# Question 4: exam date-times (lower granularity -> earliest values)
# "X'-Y'-Z'" is read as day-month-year at 14:46
joe = dt.datetime(Zp, Yp, Xp, 14, 46)
exams = {
    "Jenny": dt.datetime(1925, 10, 16, 0, 0, 0),
    "Kyle": dt.datetime(1872, 6, 23, 5, 57, 0),
    "Joe": joe,
    "Emma": dt.datetime(1944, 5, 19, 14, 33, 0),
    "Jason": dt.datetime(1851, 8, 1, 0, 0, 0),
}

order = sorted(exams.keys(), key=lambda k: exams[k], reverse=True)
final_answer = "[" + ", ".join(order) + "]"

evidence = {
    "X": X,
    "Y": Y,
    "Z": Z,
    "Xp": Xp,
    "Yp": Yp,
    "Zp": Zp,
    "joe_datetime": joe.isoformat(),
    "sorted_times": {k: exams[k].isoformat() for k in order},
}

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final_answer, "evidence": evidence}))
